description: This file defines the class 'du_srs_policy_max_ul_rate' which implements a maximum uplink throughput policy for SRS resource allocation in a 3GPP-based radio system. It includes methods for resource allocation, deallocation, and management of SRS resources across multiple cells.

classes.name: du_srs_policy_max_ul_rate
classes.description: Implements the MAX UL throughput policy for SRS resource allocation, managing resource distribution among cells and UEs.

classes.name: cell_context
classes.description: Holds per-cell SRS resource configuration and management data.

methods.name: alloc_resources
methods.description: Allocates SRS resources based on the policy priorities.

methods.name: dealloc_resources
methods.description: Deallocates SRS resources for a given cell group configuration.

methods.name: get_nof_srs_free_res_offsets
methods.description: Returns the number of free SRS resource offsets for a specified cell.

methods.name: cell_context
methods.description: Constructor initializing cell-specific SRS resource data.

methods.name: get_du_srs_res_cfg
methods.description: Retrieves the SRS resource configuration for a given cell resource ID.

methods.name: find_optimal_ue_srs_resource
methods.description: Finds the best SRS resource and offset for a UE according to the policy.

methods.name: offset_interval_used_not_full
methods.description: Checks if a symbol offset has available capacity for additional SRS resources.
